note: Registry of research datasets for the offline archive. Locations are git refs of quiquandon-oss/PulseWorkerV2 or paths in a local working directory. Status values: PREREGISTRATION (frozen rules, byte-exact), FROZEN_SNAPSHOT (study input or output that must never change), PROSPECTIVE_APPEND_ONLY (keeps growing; past partitions never rewritten), MUTABLE_EXPORT (overwritten in place; history only in git), RUN_RECORD (one file per run), EPHEMERAL_LOCAL (exists only in a session container).
